title: Evidence levels and verdict words
summary: Drake labels every claim with the narrowest true level: PROPOSED, IMPLEMENTED, EXERCISED, QUALIFIED, then MERGED and DEPLOYED for where code is. Gates speak in verdict words: PASS, FAIL, NOT_RUN, BLOCKED_HARDWARE, BLOCKED_OPERATOR, MISSING_IMPLEMENTATION. The rule that matters: NOT_RUN is not PASS, and an empty log is not a PASS either. I can walk you through gatesum.om, a fail-closed summarizer in Omega where PASS must be earned by every line.
goal: Learn the evidence ladder and the verdict words, and build a summarizer that can never turn NOT_RUN into PASS.
key_steps: Pick the narrowest true level for each claim
Use the repository verdict words, never your own synonyms
Make PASS the one verdict that must be earned: at least one line, every line PASS
Refuse lines you do not understand instead of ignoring them
Give each verdict its own exit code
Run the summarizer on NOT_RUN, FAIL, BLOCKED, unknown and empty logs as negative controls

example.code:
note gatesum: fail-closed summary of a gate log read on stdin, one verdict word at the start of each line
note PASS only when there is at least one line and every line is PASS; anything else wins over PASS
note exit 0 PASS, 1 FAIL, 2 NOT_RUN, 3 BLOCKED, 4 REFUSED (unknown word or input too big), 5 MISSING_IMPLEMENTATION
text words "PASS FAIL NOT_RUN BLOCKED_HARDWARE BLOCKED_OPERATOR MISSING_IMPLEMENTATION "
text tlines "lines "
text tpass "PASS "
text tfail "FAIL "
text tnrun "NOT_RUN "
text tblk "BLOCKED_* "
text tmiss "MISSING_IMPLEMENTATION "
text tunk "unknown "
text tverd "verdict "
text vpass "PASS"
text vfail "FAIL"
text vnrun "NOT_RUN"
text vblk "BLOCKED"
text vref "REFUSED"
text vmiss "MISSING_IMPLEMENTATION"
text nl "\n"
note cnt: 0 PASS, 1 FAIL, 2 NOT_RUN, 3 BLOCKED_HARDWARE, 4 BLOCKED_OPERATOR, 5 MISSING, 6 unknown, 7 lines
global cnt ulong 8
fn tally a ulong b ulong to void
note a .. b-1 is one line without its newline; empty lines are not counted
if lt a b
e = wordend a b
k = lookup words a e
if lt k 0
k = 6
end
i = ulong k
put cnt i add get cnt i 1
put cnt 7 add get cnt 7 1
end
end
fn kv t view uchar * v ulong to void
ot t
on v
ot nl
end
fn verdict to int
if gt get cnt 1 0
ret 1
end
if gt get cnt 6 0
ret 4
end
if gt get cnt 5 0
ret 5
end
if gt add get cnt 3 get cnt 4 0
ret 3
end
if gt get cnt 2 0
ret 2
end
if eq get cnt 0 0
note no PASS line at all: an empty log is NOT_RUN, never a vacuous PASS
ret 2
end
ret 0
end
fn vname v int to void
ot tverd
if eq v 0
ot vpass
end
if eq v 1
ot vfail
end
if eq v 2
ot vnrun
end
if eq v 3
ot vblk
end
if eq v 4
ot vref
end
if eq v 5
ot vmiss
end
ot nl
end
fn main to int
r = rdall
if lt r 0
ret 4
end
n = ulong r
a = ulong 0
for i ulong n
if eq get inb i 10
tally a i
a = add i 1
end
end
tally a n
if eq get st 2 1
put cnt 6 add get cnt 6 1
end
kv tlines get cnt 7
kv tpass get cnt 0
kv tfail get cnt 1
kv tnrun get cnt 2
kv tblk add get cnt 3 get cnt 4
kv tmiss get cnt 5
kv tunk get cnt 6
v = verdict
vname v
f = flush
if ne f 0
ret 4
end
ret v
end

common_mistake: Saying 'all tests pass' when two were skipped for lack of a GPU. Write '31 PASS, 2 NOT_RUN (no GPU)' and let the overall verdict be NOT_RUN. Never promote a host run to QUALIFIED.
